outcome_vocabulary.description: The canonical operation completed and its result or terminal outcome is valid.
The adapter does not provide the canonical operation.
The canonical input violates the operation contract.
The host rejected or could not complete the operation.

contracts.title: Terminal write
contracts.description: Write the requested bytes or text to the caller terminal.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL write the supplied data in order to the caller terminal.
The adapter SHALL normalize the host encoding at the ODS boundary.
The adapter SHALL surface a disconnected outcome when the caller connection is unusable.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Bytes or text to write to the caller terminal.

output.description: No value is returned after a successful write.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported without fabricating terminal output.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation does not terminate the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: The adapter SHALL stop the write and enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL be surfaced as disconnected when detected during the write.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be reported as a successful write.

implementation_obligations: Preserve data order and canonical text semantics.
Do not silently discard a host failure or disconnect.

contracts.title: Terminal key input
contracts.description: Wait for and return one terminal input unit.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL wait for one input unit when the connection remains usable.
The returned key SHALL preserve the canonical input meaning rather than a host-specific code.
The adapter SHALL surface a disconnected outcome when the caller connection is unusable.

output.description: The canonical input unit received from the caller.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported without blocking for input.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation returns one key and leaves the session active.
lifecycle.disconnect: The adapter SHALL stop waiting and enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL be surfaced as disconnected rather than as a key.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be represented as input.

implementation_obligations: Do not reinterpret a disconnect or host failure as ordinary input.
Preserve the canonical distinction between a key and a line.

contracts.title: Terminal line input
contracts.description: Read an edited line of terminal input.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL read one line subject to the supplied maximum length.
The adapter SHALL preserve the canonical text result and its editing boundary.
The adapter SHALL surface a disconnected outcome when the caller connection is unusable.

inputs.name: max_length
inputs.description: Maximum canonical length accepted for the line.

output.description: The edited line of caller input.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported without entering a line-input wait.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation returns one line and leaves the session active.
lifecycle.disconnect: The adapter SHALL stop line input and enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL be surfaced as disconnected rather than an incomplete successful line.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be reported as line input.

implementation_obligations: Reject an invalid maximum length deterministically.
Do not silently convert disconnect into end-of-line success.
compatibility_notes: Editing behavior is part of the host adapter contract, not a language-specific API.

contracts.title: Session identity
contracts.description: Return stable caller identity fields available from the host.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL return the identity fields that the host can establish.
Opaque identifiers SHALL NOT be renumbered by the adapter.

output.description: Canonical caller identity fields and opaque identifiers.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported when the host cannot provide the canonical identity operation.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation returns identity data without terminating the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: A disconnect observed while obtaining identity SHALL enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss is not identity data and SHALL be surfaced as disconnected when observed.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be reported as identity data.

implementation_obligations: Preserve opaque user and node identifiers.
Distinguish unavailable identity from a fabricated identity value.

contracts.title: Session node
contracts.description: Return the host node identifier for the door session.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL return the node identifier established for the session.
The node identifier SHALL remain opaque at the ODS boundary.

output.description: The opaque host node identifier for this session.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported when no host node identifier is available.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation returns the node identifier without terminating the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: A disconnect observed while obtaining the node SHALL enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss is not a node identifier and SHALL be surfaced as disconnected when observed.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be reported as a node identifier.

implementation_obligations: Do not renumber or infer a node identifier from a host name.
Report host failure when the node cannot be established.

contracts.title: Session time left
contracts.description: Return remaining session time in seconds when known.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL report remaining time in canonical seconds when the host provides it.
The adapter SHALL normalize host units before returning a result.

output.description: Remaining session time expressed in canonical seconds.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported when remaining time is not available or cannot be normalized.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation returns remaining time without terminating the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: A disconnect observed while obtaining time SHALL enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss is not a time value and SHALL be surfaced as disconnected when observed.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be reported as remaining time.

implementation_obligations: Convert host units to seconds without silently changing meaning.
Do not invent remaining time when the host does not expose it.
compatibility_notes: A host value in another unit requires an explicit normalization step.

contracts.title: Session connection state
contracts.description: Report whether the remote caller connection remains usable.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL report the canonical connection state observed by the host.
The adapter SHALL not report a usable connection after disconnect has been observed.

output.description: The canonical state of the caller connection.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported when connection state cannot be observed.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation reports state without terminating the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: The disconnected state SHALL lead to lifecycle.disconnect for terminal work.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL be represented as a disconnected connection state.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be represented as a caller connection state.

implementation_obligations: Keep the reported state consistent with terminal operation outcomes.
Do not turn an unknown observation into a connected state.

contracts.title: Set host-visible status
contracts.description: Set a short host-visible activity description.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL submit the supplied activity description to the host status surface.
The adapter SHALL preserve the canonical text meaning and report host rejection.

output.description: No value is returned after a successful status update.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported when the host has no canonical status surface.

lifecycle.normal_completion: The operation updates status without terminating the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: A disconnect observed while updating status SHALL enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL be surfaced as disconnected rather than a successful status update.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be reported as a status update.

implementation_obligations: Reject invalid status text deterministically.
Distinguish host-visible activity status from account or node state.

contracts.title: Host command
contracts.description: Request execution of a host command through an adapter-defined command namespace.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL submit the canonical command and arguments through its declared host command namespace.
The adapter SHALL return a canonical command result or surface the host outcome.
The adapter MUST NOT expose an undocumented command as a guaranteed canonical command.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: Canonical or declared host command identifier.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.description: Arguments accepted by the declared command.

output.description: The canonical result of the host command request.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported for a command namespace or command it does not provide.

lifecycle.normal_completion: A successful command returns its result without implicitly terminating the session.
lifecycle.disconnect: A disconnect during command execution SHALL enter lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL be surfaced as disconnected rather than command success.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown MUST NOT be hidden as a command result.

implementation_obligations: Validate command and argument semantics before dispatch.
Keep the declared command namespace separate from undocumented host internals.
compatibility_notes: Host command support is profile-dependent and may be outside a profile guarantee.

contracts.title: Normal lifecycle exit
contracts.description: Finish normally and return control to the host.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL complete the documented normal-exit path and return control to the host.
The adapter SHALL preserve the canonical exit status when the host can represent it.
After normal exit begins, new interactive operations MUST NOT start.

output.description: Control returns to the host rather than producing a further operation result.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL report unsupported before beginning exit when normal exit cannot be performed.

lifecycle.normal_completion: Success returns control to the host through the normal completion path.
lifecycle.disconnect: Normal exit MUST NOT hide a known disconnect; the terminal outcome is lifecycle.disconnect.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss SHALL select lifecycle.disconnect rather than normal completion.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown is cleanup in support of exit and is not a substitute for the canonical exit outcome.

implementation_obligations: Prevent new interactive work after exit begins.
Return control exactly through the declared normal lifecycle path.

contracts.title: Disconnect lifecycle termination
contracts.description: Terminate promptly after carrier loss or equivalent connection failure.
normative_behavior: The adapter SHALL terminate promptly after a disconnected outcome is observed.
The adapter SHALL preserve a canonical disconnect reason where one is available.
After disconnect termination begins, further blocking terminal work MUST NOT occur.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Canonical reason for connection loss or equivalent disconnect.

output.description: Control leaves the interactive session through disconnect termination.

contracts.unsupported_behavior: The adapter SHALL treat inability to perform disconnect cleanup as a host failure and MUST NOT resume interactive work.

lifecycle.normal_completion: Disconnect termination is not normal completion and MUST NOT be reported as lifecycle.exit.
lifecycle.disconnect: The adapter SHALL enter this terminal path once a disconnect is established.
lifecycle.carrier_loss: Carrier loss is a cause of disconnect and SHALL map to this path without being renamed normal exit.
lifecycle.implementation_shutdown: Implementation shutdown SHALL release resources while preserving the disconnect outcome.

implementation_obligations: Stop blocking terminal work promptly.
Make cleanup safe to repeat without producing a second lifecycle outcome.
compatibility_notes: Carrier loss, host shutdown, and adapter error may have different causes but all require explicit canonical handling.
